entries.name: Lao New Year (Pi Mai Lao)
entries.capsule: The traditional Lao new year in mid-April, marked with temple merit-making, water blessings, food, music and community celebrations.
entries.dateRule: Mid-April, usually April 14 to 16, as set each year by the Lao government. Minnesota celebrations are often held on a nearby weekend, sometimes weeks later.

dates.source: Vientiane Times (official April 14 to 16 dates); Lao News Agency (KPL) reports celebrations launched April 14, 2026
Calculated (python-holidays, Laos module)

entries.whatItMarks: The start of the traditional Lao year.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Long hosted by Lao temples; in 2013 younger leaders brought more than 20 organizations together in Crystal for a community-wide celebration with a pageant (MPR News). In southwestern Minnesota, the Worthington temple community celebrated on a weekend after mid-April at the Brewster American Legion Hall, with free food and Lao music (2015). The United Senior Lao American Association sought a state grant for Lao New Year 2025. No Minnesota announcement for 2026 was found; in Laos the 2026 holiday ran April 14 to 16.

entries.name: Asanha Bucha and start of Buddhist Lent
entries.capsule: Marks the Buddha's first sermon and the start of the three-month rains retreat for monks.
entries.dateRule: Full moon of the eighth lunar month, usually July. In Laos, Boun Khao Phansa is observed on that full-moon day (Lao News Agency, 2026), which begins the three-month rains retreat; Thai calendars place the start of Lent on the following day.

entries.name: Boun Ok Phansa (end of Buddhist Lent)
entries.capsule: Ends the three-month rains retreat; families bring food and gifts to monks, and in Laos float lighted boats on rivers.
entries.dateRule: Full moon of the eleventh lunar month, usually October, three lunar months after Khao Phansa; announced in Laos each year. Robe-offering (kathin) ceremonies at temples follow in the weeks after.

entries.name: Lao Artists Heritage Month
entries.capsule: A month recognizing Lao American artists; a Minnesota governor issued a proclamation, and Lao exhibits have opened during it.
entries.dateRule: August. Sahtu Press posted 'Lao American Artist Heritage Month 2024' on Aug. 30, 2024, calling it the 12th year the community observed the month, and described an Aug. 1 opening as during the month.

entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Former Gov. Mark Dayton issued a Lao Artists Heritage Month proclamation honoring playwright Saymoukda Duangphouxay Vongsay (University of Minnesota CCAPS, 2022). Laomerica 50 opened at Minneapolis Central Library on Aug. 1, 2024, during the month (Sahtu Press). Sahtu Press said in 2024 that the proclamation's wording changes from year to year.
